steps.what: Review department obligations, resources and unresolved administrative matters
Perform administrative duties by resolving priorities and directing department activities

tasks.design: Keep department decisions and coordination with the teacher serving as head, using existing {PROJECT} and {DOCS} information. Any specific duplicate reporting process needs separate measurement before a saving is claimed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Department leadership involves competing needs and incomplete information.
tasks.enabler_now: Current records support decisions without establishing an automated substitute for leadership.
tasks.still_hard: Resource conflicts, sensitive staff concerns and institutional constraints require judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The department head can negotiate priorities and take responsibility for their consequences.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in department decision rights or assumed leadership time.

reach.task: Discuss programme priorities and resource constraints

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: substantive department administration is leadership and coordination; no specific repeat clerical process has been established here.

assumptions: Boundary covers the teacher's department-head review and coordination, excluding separate finance, HR and programme-office execution.

Existing record owners produce resource and obligation information; the head checks completeness during counted s1 and elicits staff responses during s2 before treating directions as agreed. No structured priority or capacity flag is presumed reliable without checking.
Inspect native project and administrative views before custom tools; existing system runtime receives no saving.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new automation or recurring reporting is introduced.
unknowns: Which repeated clerical work remains manual
research_questions: Can a specific duplicate report or entry process be timed independently of leadership work?

already_counted.description: Resolve priorities and coordinate department activity

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Routine department business and contested priorities both retain human leadership; no generic administrative share is assumed removable.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in campus and community events

steps.what: Participate in campus and community events, contributing to activities and conversations

tasks.design: Retain personal event participation with existing {CALENDAR} support. The teacher contributes to activities and conversations that build campus and community relationships.
tasks.previous_blocker: Participation has value because the person is present and engaged.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing event information helps attendance but does not replace involvement.
tasks.still_hard: Useful contributions depend on the event and the people encountered.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher builds trust through direct, responsive participation.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in participation responsibilities or assumed time.

reach.task: Discuss a community learning activity with participants

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: personal campus and community participation retains human time; automated invitations do not replace it.

assumptions: Boundary covers the teacher's participation, excluding event-office administration and other participants' time.

Event organizers produce invitations and activity details before participation; the teacher checks them during counted s1. Participant responses arise during the event rather than being assumed available beforehand.
Use native calendar invitations before custom event tools.
Zero incremental upkeep because no automated process or additional reporting is proposed.
research_questions: Is any distinct repetitive event administration assigned to this role?

already_counted.description: Prepare for and participate in the event

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Routine campus occasions and relationship-focused community events both retain personal participation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Act as advisers to student organizations, discussing aims, difficulties and possible next steps

tasks.design: Keep student-organization advice personal, using {DOCS} guidance and {EMAIL} for context. The teacher helps students examine options while preserving their responsibility for the organization's choices.
tasks.previous_blocker: Useful advice depends on the group's aims, relationships and current difficulty.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing guidance provides reference material without replacing the conversation.
tasks.still_hard: Sensitive disagreements and unclear responsibilities need trust and judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The adviser helps students learn to decide rather than supplying a generic answer.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in advisory responsibility or assumed time.

reach.task: Help students reflect on a difficult collective decision

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: contextual student-organization advice remains human work; generic guidance does not establish shorter advising time.

assumptions: Boundary is advisory discussion, excluding student execution, event administration and formal institutional approval.

Students produce their questions and activity proposals before or during advice. The teacher checks relevant guidance and clarifies missing context during fully counted s1; no pre-existing suitability flag is presumed.
Use native guidance pages and communication tools before custom answer software.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new automation or guidance-maintenance process is introduced.
research_questions: Is there a distinct repeated factual query that can be measured separately from contextual advice?

already_counted.description: Listen, clarify context and advise students

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Familiar planning questions and sensitive group disagreements both retain contextual advice.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Clarify the consulting problem and evaluate relevant sociological evidence and client context
Provide professional consulting advice and discuss its limits with government or industry clients

tasks.design: Retain evidence assessment and consulting dialogue with the teacher, using {DOCS} research and {EMAIL} context. A separate measured report-production task could be assisted later; this design does not assume every consultation requires one.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advice depends on the client's context and the applicability of research findings.
tasks.enabler_now: Current research access supports the assessment without replacing professional judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Research may not transfer to the client's population, institution or intended policy.
tasks.human_edge: The consultant explains limitations and challenges an inappropriate interpretation of evidence.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in consulting responsibility or assumed time.

reach.task: Assess evidence supporting a proposed educational policy

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: professional consulting assessment and dialogue remain human work; no distinct repeat artefact-production baseline is established here.

assumptions: Boundary covers problem clarification, evidence assessment and advice, excluding client implementation and separately commissioned research or reports.

The client supplies the question and context; the teacher verifies missing facts and source relevance during counted s1. Client follow-up questions arrive during s2. No decision-ready evidence rating or client response is assumed beforehand.
Use existing research and document tools before custom consulting support.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new automation or recurring report obligation is proposed.
unknowns: Whether repetitive document production is actually present
research_questions: Can a distinct repeat drafting component be timed without removing contextual assessment or discussion?

already_counted.description: Clarify context and assess research relevance
Provide advice and explain its limits

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Routine consultations and novel policy questions both retain evidence assessment and professional dialogue.
